description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Accuracy (%) and the Number of Frames for four different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Frames" and uses a linear scale with values ranging from 8 to 64, featuring tick marks at intervals of 10 from 10 to 60. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from below 40 to above 54, with tick marks at intervals of 2 from 40 to 54. The line representing "Ours (Dynamic Seg)" is a solid blue line with circular markers; it starts at an accuracy of 53 at 8 frames, peaks at 54 at 16 frames, and slightly declines to 53.6 at 64 frames. The line for "Ours (Static 4-Seg)" is a solid green line with circular markers, beginning at 52.6 at 8 frames, rising to 53.6 at 16 frames, reaching 53.8 at 32 frames, and remaining steady at 53.8 through 64 frames. The "PLLaVA (DP 8)" line is a solid orange line with square markers that shows a steady decline, starting at 45 at 8 frames, dropping to 43 at 16 frames, 41 at 32 frames, and ending at 39.4 at 64 frames. Finally, the "PLLaVA (DP 16)" line is a solid red line with square markers; it begins at 16 frames with a value of 45.6, and steadily declines to 43.8 at 32 frames and 42.2 at 64 frames.
